qualification.source_level_gap_remediation: v1.2 restores explicit Monday daily-briefing handoff, previous-workday default, and separate host-managed optional scheduling proposal.

limitations: The ten reports were constructed by one analyst from synthetic source packets, then checked against limited structural and case-specific assertions. Outputs are not independent host execution of either SKILL.md. All claims are bounded by supplied fictional evidence. Five patterns per legacy skill, no quality ratio or universal behavioral parity.
